w: quick start # quick start jade agent stack is one python package, `jade-agent-stack`, that drives the four jade repositories through their documented interfaces. it is a client and needs the network to reach them. | repository | role | the toolkit uses | | --- | --- | --- | | jade vault | control plane: agent loop, schedules, approvals, the person | http api `/v1` (header auth) | | jade agent base | resource plane: identity, database, model gateway, billing, audit log | rest `/api/agent/tools`, mcp `/api/agent/mcp` | | jade agent kit | the embeddable subset of vault (an agent in any web page) | a generated page that loads it | | jade agent ui/ux | presentation: web components | generated html that loads them |
install ## install ```sh pip install jade-agent-stack # python 3.11+; needs only pyyaml pip install "jade-agent-stack[keyring]" # store tokens in the os keyring ```

connect ## connect ```sh jade init # seven steps; resumable; --yes for defaults, --answers file for headless jade doctor # reachable, authenticated, compatible, no tokens in urls ``` `jade init` writes `jade.config.yaml` (found later by walking up from the working directory, or `$jade_config`). tokens go to the os keyring under `jade.<host>`, never into the file.

build a site ## build a site ```sh jade site new "acme ai" --template saas --tagline "embeddings for every app." jade site build # → dist/ (static files) jade site preview # http://127.0.0.1:8080 jade site plan # every base call a deploy makes; makes none jade site deploy # collections, modules, models, plans, billing, then the files ```

run a playbook ## run a playbook ```sh jade playbook check examples/base-products.playbook.yaml jade playbook plan examples/base-products.playbook.yaml jade playbook approve base-products jade playbook run base-products --var collection=products ```
find help ## find help ```sh jade docs topics jade docs search "idempotency key" jade docs show playbooks#failure-modes jade commands # every command with its parameters, as data ```
for agents # for agents read this page, then only what a task needs (`jade docs show <topic>#<section>`). prefer `--json` output.

rules ## rules | rule | why | | --- | --- | | start from a template: `name`, `tagline`, `template` is a whole site | three lines instead of hundreds | | `jade site sections` (one line each), `jade site sections <name>` (one in full) | do not guess parameters | | `jade site plan` before `jade site deploy` | see every call; makes none | | mutations carry idempotency keys automatically | a retry never runs twice | | a `jade103` (credential refused) or `jade30x` (safety) error means stop | do not retry around a refusal | | secrets only by environment variable name (`api_key_env`) | never write a key into a file |

a site in one file ## a site in one file ```yaml # jade.site.yaml name: acme ai tagline: embeddings for every app. template: saas # saas, chatbot, landing, waitlist, docs, portfolio, shop, dashboard url: https://acme.example.com backend: url: https://acme.example.com ``` ```sh jade site check --json && jade site build --json && jade site deploy --yes --json ```

reuse a design ## reuse a design when a design is settled, `jade site template save name` keeps it; later sites are `name`, `tagline`, `template: name`. read `jade site templates` before building anything new.

change one page ## change one page pages from the spec replace the template's page with the same path; sections are a list: ```yaml pages: - path: / title: home sections: - nav - {type: hero, title: "search that understands", buttons: [{label: try it, href: /playground}]} - {type: form, collection: waitlist, fields: ["email:email!"], submit: join} - footer backend: collections: - {name: waitlist, fields: "email:email!", create: anyone, list: admin} ```

drive it from a program ## drive it from a program | surface | use | | --- | --- | | `jade <command> --json` | one call, one json object (`schema: jade.v1`) | | `jade repl --jsonl` | many calls over a pipe: `{"id":1,"cmd":"site.build","args":{}}` | | `jade mcp` | mcp over stdio: tools `site_build`, `playbook_run`, `docs_search`, … | | `jade serve` | http: `post /v1/commands/site.build`, `post /v1/playbooks/{name}/run` | | `import jade` | `jade.site(...)`, `jade.stack.load().run("site.build", dir=".")` |

what needs a person ## what needs a person an agent must not widen its own permissions. over mcp, http and json lines these are refused with jade302 and need a person in a terminal: changing `approvals`, target urls, `secrets.file` or `accept_legacy`; storing or deleting secrets; `playbook approve`; `site deploy --yes`. everything else, including `jade init --answers file`, an agent can do. this guard holds for those surfaces. an agent with a shell running as you can do what you can, so run agents as a user with less.
errors ## errors every error has a stable code and a remediation (`jade docs show errors`). exit codes: 0 ok, 1 user error, 2 remote error, 3 refused for safety.

sites # sites a site is one file, `jade.site.yaml`, compiled to static html that loads jade agent ui/ux from its cdn. with a backend, the same spec also sets up jade agent base: collections, modules, sign-in providers, models, plans and billing.

spec ## spec | key | type | default | meaning | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `name` | string | required | the site name (brand, titles) | | `tagline` | string | `""` | one line under the name (hero default) | | `description` | string | tagline | meta description | | `template` | string | none | `saas`, `chatbot`, `landing`, `waitlist`, `docs`, `portfolio`, `shop`, `dashboard` | | `theme` | string or mapping | `jade` | a theme name, or `{name, mode: auto/light/dark, accent: "#hex", …}` | | `url` | url | none | public address: canonical links, sitemap, base `appurl` | | `lang` | string | `en` | page language | | `logo`, `favicon` | url | none | images | | `cdn` | mapping | pinned | `{ui: url, kit: url}` to override the pinned module urls | | `static` | folder | `static` | files copied as they are (images, robots) | | `head` | html | none | added to every `<head>` | | `pages` | list | template's | `{path, title, description, nav, nav_label, sections}` | | `backend` | mapping | none | see below |

templates ## templates a template supplies pages and backend defaults. pages in the spec replace the template's page at the same path; backend lists (collections, providers, models, plans) merge by `name`. `jade site templates` lists them.

reusing a design ## reusing a design a settled design does not need rebuilding. save it once and start new sites from it: ```sh jade site template save house --about "our look: ocean theme, pricing, account" # → ~/.config/jade/templates/house.yaml jade site template save house --project # → ./templates/house.yaml (commit it) ``` ```yaml name: second product tagline: same look, new idea. template: house # or a path: template: ../brand/site.yaml ``` templates are looked up in `./templates`, then your own, then the built-in ones; a template may itself name a `template` to build on. saved ui (a dashboard, a calculator) can live in a file and be reused by a surface section: `{type: surface, file: dashboards/sales.yaml}`.

themes ## themes `jade site themes` lists them: jade, midnight, paper, contrast, sunset, ocean, forest, rose, mono, neon, slate, terminal. each has a light and a dark palette, a font and a radius. visitors switch with the theme toggle in the nav.

backend ## backend | key | shape | becomes (base tool) | | --- | --- | --- | | `url` | url | `<meta name="jade-base">` in every page | | `modules` | `[gateway, billing]` | `module_enable` | | `rate_limits` | `true` or `{rules: [...]}` | `rate_limits` | | `auth.password` | bool | password sign-in on or off | | `auth.providers` | `[{name: google, client_id_env, client_secret_env}]` | `auth_provider_set` (oauth2) | | `collections` | `[{name, fields: "email:email!, note:text", list, view, create, update, delete}]` | `collection_get`, then `collection_create` or `collection_update` | | `providers` | `[{name, type, base_url, api_key_env}]` | `provider_set` | | `models` | `[{name, provider, upstream, kind, price_in, price_out}]` | `model_set` | | `plans` | `[{name, price_month, monthly_tokens, rpm, default, description}]` | `plan_set` | | `billing` | `{secret_key_env, webhook_secret_env, currency, publish: [pro]}` | `billing_setup`, `plan_publish` | field shorthand: `name:type!` (`!` = required). types: text, email, url, number, bool, date, json, editor, select, file, relation, textarea, checkbox. rule shorthands: `anyone`, `users` (signed in), `owner` (adds a `user` relation), `admin` (no rule: superusers only), or a pocketbase rule.

build, preview, deploy ## build, preview, deploy | command | does | | --- | --- | | `jade site check` | validates and compiles in memory; lists warnings | | `jade site build [--out dist]` | writes `index.html` per page (`/pricing` → `pricing/index.html`), `404.html`, `sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt` | | `jade site preview [--port 8080]` | builds and serves on localhost | | `jade site plan` | the deploy as a list of base calls; secrets as placeholders; makes none | | `jade site deploy [--yes]` | runs the deploy as a playbook through the harness | a deploy is a generated playbook: approvals apply, every mutation has a content-hash idempotency key (deploying the same thing twice changes nothing), the run uses a short-lived task credential with only the scopes it needs, and an interrupted deploy resumes where it stopped. secrets come from the environment variables the spec names.

from python ## from python ```python import jade site = jade.site("acme ai", tagline="embeddings for every app.", template="saas") site.page("/", "home").add("nav").add("hero").add("pricing").add("footer") site.collection("waitlist", "email:email!", create="anyone", list="admin") site.build("dist") ```

playbooks # playbooks a playbook (`*.playbook.yaml`) compiles to each target's existing primitives: base tools, vault's http api, a kit page and local commands. it does not replace vault playbooks, flows or jade lisp. the schema is `schema/playbook.v1.json` (and `jade docs show playbook-schema`).

example ## example ```yaml apiversion: jade/v1 kind: playbook metadata: {name: base-products, description: a products collection} spec: targets: [base] scopes: [read, write, schema] # the run's short-lived task credential vars: {collection: products} defaults: {fail_mode: rollback} tasks: - name: products collection tool: collection_create args: {name: "{{ collection }}", fields: [{name: title, type: text}]} register: col undo: {tool: collection_delete, args: {name: "{{ collection }}", confirm: "{{ collection }}"}} ```

targets ## targets | target | tools | notes | | --- | --- | --- | | `base` | every tool the token may use (`jade base tools`) | arguments are checked against the tool's schema at check time | | `vault` | `chat`, `flow`, `status`, `flows`, `chats`, `history` | vault-only tools (ui_render, notify) run inside a vault flow | | `kit` | `page` | writes a page that runs kit in a browser | | `local` | `command: "…"` | allowed by `approvals.shell` | a task without `target` goes to the one allowed target that owns the tool; two owners is an error.

task fields ## task fields | field | type | meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | `name` | string | shown in events and logs | | `target` | vault, base, kit, local | where it runs | | `tool` / `command` / `block` | string / string / list | exactly one | | `args` | mapping | the tool's arguments (expressions allowed) | | `register` | name | keep `{ok, changed, result, error}` under this name | | `when` | expression | run only if true | | `retries`, `delay` | int 0–10, seconds | try again on failure or while `until` is false | | `until` | expression | done when true | | `undo` | `{tool, args, target}` or `{command}` | how to reverse it (rollback) | | `idempotency_key` | string | override the default key | | `fail_mode` | stop, continue, rollback | this task's failure handling | | `rescue`, `always` | lists | with `block`: on failure / in every case | | `timeout` | duration | for this call |

expressions ## expressions `{{ name }}`, `{{ created.result.id }}`, `{{ items.0 }}`, literals, `==` `!=` `<` `<=` `>` `>=` `and` `or` `not` `in`, filters `default(x)` `lower` `upper` `trim` `json` `length` `string` `int`. `{% raw %}…{% endraw %}` keeps text as it is. no calls, no imports, no i/o. an unknown name is an error unless `| default()` is used.

failure modes ## failure modes | mode | on a failed task | | --- | --- | | `stop` | stop the run (default) | | `continue` | go on with the next task; the run stays ok (use it for checks like "is it there?") | | `rollback` | run each finished task's `undo` in reverse, then stop. `check` refuses a rollback playbook whose mutating tasks lack `undo` |

idempotency and resume ## idempotency and resume every mutating call carries a key: `sha256(playbook | task | vars)` by default (`idempotent_strategy: key`), `content-hash` (the rendered arguments) or `none` (a new uuidv7 each run). base runs a key once and replays the first answer. runs are recorded in `~/.local/state/jade/runs/`; running again with the same vars resumes, skipping finished tasks. states: not_started, in_progress, completed, refused, failed, interrupted, resumable.

approval ## approval a playbook that changes vault or base starts unapproved. `jade playbook approve name` signs its sha-256 with a local key; any edit invalidates it. unattended runs (`--no-input`, mcp, http) need the approval; interactive runs ask.
schedules ## schedules `spec.schedule: "every weekday at 9am"` needs the vault target: `jade playbook plan` prints the equivalent vault schedule. base has no scheduler, by design.
commands ## commands `jade playbook list | check | plan | run | approve | revoke | logs name [--var k=v …] [--json]`
harness, approvals and credentials # harness, approvals and credentials every sdk call and command goes through the harness, in the same process (no daemon).

approvals ## approvals `approvals` in `jade.config.yaml` lists what is allowed, by capability and target pattern. deny wins. a bare `true` is rejected. ```yaml approvals: base.read: ["*"] base.write: ["record_*:bookings"] # <tool>:<collection or name> base.schema: {allow: ["collection_create:*"], deny: ["collection_delete:*"]} vault.chat: ["*"] vault.flow: ["daily digest"] shell: {allow: [ls, cat, grep], deny: [rm, curl, wget]} http_request: {allow_hosts: [api.example.com], deny_hosts: ["*"]} ``` | capability | target string | | --- | --- | | `base.<scope>` (read, write, schema, hooks, site, settings, gateway, billing) | `<tool>` or `<tool>:<collection/name/path>` | | `vault.chat`, `vault.flow`, `vault.status`, … | the session or flow name | | `kit.page` | the output file | | `shell` | the command's first word | a call that no rule covers needs a person to confirm, or `--yolo`. destructive base tools (`collection_delete`, …) need confirmation even when allowed, unless their rule says `confirm: false`. every confirmation, refusal and `--yolo` is appended to `~/.local/state/jade/approvals.log` with what, when, target, task and scope.

idempotency keys ## idempotency keys mutations always carry a key: given (`idempotency_key=`), from `with harness.with_idempotency(key)`, or a new uuidv7. reads retry on network errors; mutations never retry by themselves.

task credentials ## task credentials `with harness.task("job-42", scopes=["read", "write"]):` mints a base credential (15 minutes by default, `targets.base.credentials.ttl`) and uses it for the calls inside, then revokes it. playbooks with `spec.scopes` do this for the whole run. a 403 `credential_refused` (jade103) stops the run: it is not retried.

compatibility ## compatibility `jade doctor` compares each target's version with stack.md: another major version is refused (jade203), an older minor is a warning. a vault that accepts `?token=` is refused (jade102) unless `--accept-legacy`.
routing ## routing `harness.call(none, "records_list", …)` goes to the one configured target that has the tool. two owners: name the target, or set `playbooks.routes.<tool>: base` in the config.
python api # python api ```python import jade stack = jade.stack.load() # jade.config.yaml upward from here, or $jade_config ```

stack ## stack | member | returns | raises | | --- | --- | --- | | `stack.load(path=none, *, yolo=false, accept_legacy=false, ask=none)` | `stack` | `jadeerror` (jade400 bad config) | | `stack.doctor()` | `{"ok", "targets", "problems"}` | never for target problems; they are in the result | | `stack.call(target, tool, args=none, *, idempotency_key=none, timeout=none)` | the tool's result | `safetyerror` (jade30x), `remoteerror` (jade2xx), `autherror` (jade101) | | `stack.base` | `baseclient`: `tools(format)`, `call(name, args, idempotency_key=)`, `mint(task, scopes, ttl)`, `audit()` | as above | | `stack.vault` | `vaultclient`: `status()`, `chat(message, session=)`, `flow(name, input)`, `flows()` | jade102 if vault accepts url tokens | | `stack.kit.page(features, ollama=, model=, out=)` | `{"html", "manifest"}` | jade400 unknown feature | | `stack.ui.chat(mount=, theme=, base=, out=)` | `{"html"}` | jade400 unknown mount | | `stack.agent(name, target="vault"\|"base")` | `agent`: `ask(text)`, `stream(text)` | as `call` | | `stack.run(command, **args)` | any command's result (`jade commands`) | `jadeerror` | ```python stack = jade.stack.load() print(stack.call("base", "records_list", {"collection": "posts"})) ```

site ## site ```python site = jade.site("acme", tagline="hi", template="landing") site.page("/about", "about").add("nav").add("markdown", text="# about").add("footer") result = site.build("dist") # {"out", "pages", "files", "bytes", "warnings"} ```

playbooks ## playbooks ```python pb = jade.playbook.load("examples/base-products.playbook.yaml") pb.check(stack.harness); plan = pb.plan({"collection": "items"}) for event in pb.run(stack.harness, {"collection": "items"}): print(event["event"]) ```
docs ## docs ```python jade.docs.topics(); jade.docs.show("playbooks#targets"); jade.docs.search("credential") ```
asyncio ## asyncio ```python stack = await jade.aio.stack.load() reply = await stack.agent("booker", target="base").ask("how many products?") ```
errors ## errors all errors derive from `jade.jadeerror` with `.code`, `.message`, `.remediation`, `.exit_code`; `str(e)` includes the remediation and never a secret. see `jade docs show errors`.
cli, repl, mcp and http # cli, repl, mcp and http one registry of commands (`jade commands`) serves every surface. results are the same json values everywhere.

cli ## cli `jade <group> <command> [args] [--json] [--verbose]`. exit codes: 0 ok, 1 user error, 2 remote error, 3 refused for safety. `--json` prints `{"schema": "jade.v1", "ok": true, "command": "…", "data": …}` or `{"ok": false, "error": {"code", "message", "remediation"}}`. `--verbose` prints http calls with authorization and secrets redacted. after a failed `jade doctor`, commands that touch targets refuse until it passes, or `--force`. completion: `eval "$(jade completion bash)"` (also zsh, fish).
repl ## repl `jade repl`: type commands without `jade`, arguments as values then `key=value` (json allowed). `help`, `help site.build`, `commands`, `docs search …`.

json lines ## json lines `jade repl --jsonl` reads one request per line and writes one answer per line: ```json {"id": 1, "cmd": "docs.search", "args": {"query": "approvals"}} {"id": 1, "schema": "jade.v1", "ok": true, "command": "docs.search", "data": [ … ]} ```

mcp ## mcp `jade mcp` serves the commands as mcp tools over stdio: `site_build`, `site_plan`, `site_deploy`, `playbook_run`, `docs_search`, `docs_show`, `base_call`, … nothing asks a person there: approvals in the config decide, and playbooks must be approved. ```json {"mcpservers": {"jade": {"command": "jade", "args": ["mcp"]}}} ```

http ## http `jade serve` (127.0.0.1:9765; other hosts need `--token`, sent as `authorization: bearer`; tokens in urls are refused): | route | does | | --- | --- | | `get /healthz` | liveness | | `get /v1/playbooks` | playbooks and their approval | | `post /v1/playbooks/{name}/run` | `{"vars": {…}, "fresh": false}` | | `get /v1/commands`, `post /v1/commands/{name}` | any command | | `get /v1/docs`, `get /v1/docs/{topic}?section=…`, `get /v1/docs/search?q=…` | the docs browser |
configuration and secrets # configuration and secrets
discovery ## discovery `$jade_config`, else the nearest `jade.config.yaml` from the working directory upward.

keys ## keys | key | type | default | meaning | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `version` | int | `1` | config format | | `targets.base.url` | url | none | jade agent base | | `targets.base.token` | string | `jade.<host>` | keyring name of the agent token | | `targets.base.credentials` | `{ttl, enabled}` | `{ttl: 15m, enabled: true}` | task credentials for playbooks | | `targets.vault.url` | url | none | vault's http api | | `targets.vault.token` | string | `jade.<host>` | keyring name | | `targets.vault.accept_legacy` | bool | `false` | diagnosis only | | `targets.kit` | `{ollama, model, features}` | none | defaults for kit pages | | `models` | `{provider, url, key, fast, strong}` | none | the model for `agent --target base` | | `approvals` | mapping | `{}` | see harness | | `defaults.timeout` / `defaults.chat_timeout` | seconds | 30 / 300 | call timeouts | | `secrets.file` | bool | `false` | allow the 0600 file store | | `playbooks.routes` | `{tool: target}` | `{}` | resolve tools two targets have | unknown keys are errors. a url with a token in it is refused.

secrets ## secrets | where | when | | --- | --- | | os keyring, service `jade` | with `keyring` installed and a backend available | | `~/.config/jade/secrets.json` (mode 0600) | only with `--accept-file-secrets` or `secrets.file: true` | | `jade_secret_<name>` environment variables | always first (ci); name upper-cased, other characters as `_` | `jade secret set name` (hidden prompt), `jade secret list` (names only), `jade secret rm name`.

the wizard ## the wizard `jade init` runs environment, targets, auth, models, permissions, smoke test, write. `--yes` takes defaults, `--answers file` (json) or `--json` runs headless, `--skip-<step>` and `--only=<step>` select steps, `--restart` forgets earlier answers (`~/.config/jade/init-state.json`). permissions default to read-only and become approval patterns. a failed smoke test leaves the previous file as it was.

architecture # architecture **vault asks. base answers. base logs. base can say no.** | part | owns | does not | | --- | --- | --- | | jade vault | the agent loop, schedules, heartbeat, autonomy, budgets, approvals, the user-facing transcript | become a server for others | | jade agent base | identity, the database, the model gateway, billing, the authoritative audit log | host an agent, schedule anything | | jade agent kit | the embeddable subset of vault: the agent in any web page | own data or identity | | jade agent ui/ux | web components and themes | talk to anything but kit and base | | jade agent stack | a client over all four: sdk, cli, wizard, harness, playbooks, sites, docs | copy their logic | the seam between vault (or kit) and base is mcp (`/api/agent/mcp`), with the same tools over rest. fleet (many terminals sharing one vault) is users, not distributed compute.

the contract, in short ## the contract, in short | topic | rule | | --- | --- | | transcript | vault owns what the person sees | | audit | base's `agent_audit` is authoritative, including refusals | | credentials | one short-lived task credential per task, least privilege, at most 24 h; revocation fails closed | | refusal | 403 `credential_refused` or a scope error: stop and tell the person; do not retry | | idempotency | every mutation has a key; base runs it once and replays the answer for 24 h | | resume | a run's state says which tasks finished; running again skips them | | phone sleeps mid-flow | the credential may expire; the run resumes with a new one and the same keys | | approvals | vault owns the model; the toolkit enforces its own copy locally (deny wins) | the full text is contract.md in the repository.
security # security

defences in the toolkit ## defences in the toolkit | defence | where | | --- | --- | | header-only auth; urls with tokens are refused (client and `jade serve`) | `jade.http`, `jade.serve` | | a vault that accepts `?token=` is refused (jade102) | `jade init`, `jade doctor`, every vault call | | secrets in the os keyring; never in config, output, logs or errors | `jade.secrets`, `jade.redact` | | local approvals, deny wins, enforced before a call leaves | `jade.approvals` | | destructive calls need a person (or a logged `--yolo`) | harness | | playbook approvals bound to the file's hash | `jade playbook approve` | | short-lived, least-privilege task credentials | base 0.6 `/api/agent/credentials` | | idempotency keys on every mutation | base 0.6 | | a sandboxed expression language (no calls, imports or i/o) | `jade.playbook.template` | | generated pages escape all text; markdown drops raw html and `javascript:` links | `jade.site` |

threats ## threats | threat | what can happen | what limits it | | --- | --- | --- | | a malicious note in vault | instructions in a note steer the agent | vault's approvals; base scopes and task credentials bound what a steered agent can do; base logs every call and refusal | | a malicious web page fetched by the agent | the same, from the web | the same; in vault, its own fetch approvals; no url tokens to leak | | a malicious mcp server | tool descriptions or results that steer the agent; data exfiltration | vault approves mcp servers; in the toolkit, approvals per tool and target; credentials are per task and short | | a stolen vault token used against base | vault's agent token is not a base token; a base token vault holds can act within its scopes | task credentials expire in minutes; revoking the agent ends them all; `schema`, `hooks`, `settings` are root-equivalent: give them sparingly | | a compromised base used against vault | answers that steer vault's agent; false data | treat base results as data, not instructions; approvals still apply in vault and the toolkit | | a leaked toolkit config | urls and approval rules | no secrets in it by design | | a shared terminal log | a token in a url or header | url tokens refused; `--verbose` redacts authorization and registered secrets |
reporting ## reporting report vulnerabilities privately to the maintainer through github security advisories on the repository concerned.

errors # errors stable codes. `str(error)` gives the message and the remediation. exit codes: 0 ok, 1 user error, 2 remote error, 3 refused for safety. | code | meaning | exit | remediation | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `jade100` | not configured | 1 | run `jade init`, or set jade_config to a jade.config.yaml. | | `jade101` | bad token | 1 | the server refused the token. make a new one and store it: `jade secret set <name>`. | | `jade102` | legacy query-string authentication refused | 3 | this vault accepts ?token= in urls. update jade vault to 2.18.3 or later. only for diagnosis: --accept-legacy. | | `jade103` | credential refused | 3 | base refused the task credential (revoked or expired). the task stops; it is not retried. start the task again. | | `jade104` | secret store unavailable | 1 | install keyring (`pip install keyring`), or allow a 0600 file with --accept-file-secrets. | | `jade105` | missing secret | 1 | store it with `jade secret set <name>`, or set the environment variable jade_secret_<name>. | | `jade200` | cannot reach the target | 2 | check the url in jade.config.yaml and that the server is running (`jade doctor`). | | `jade201` | mcp protocol mismatch | 2 | the server speaks another mcp protocol version. update the server or the toolkit. | | `jade202` | remote error | 2 | the target answered with an error; the message says which. | | `jade203` | incompatible version | 2 | the target's version is outside what stack.md allows. upgrade the target or the toolkit (`jade doctor`). | | `jade204` | timed out | 2 | the call took longer than its timeout. pass timeout= / --timeout, or check the target. | | `jade205` | idempotency conflict | 2 | the same idempotency key was used with other arguments. use a new key for a new call. | | `jade300` | approval required | 3 | allow it in jade.config.yaml under approvals, or confirm interactively. | | `jade301` | denied by approvals | 3 | a deny rule in jade.config.yaml matches. deny wins; change the rule to allow it. | | `jade302` | unsafe without confirmation | 3 | destructive or unknown operations need a person to confirm, or --yolo (logged). | | `jade303` | playbook not approved | 3 | review it, then `jade playbook approve <name>`. any edit needs a new approval. | | `jade400` | invalid configuration | 1 | fix jade.config.yaml at the place the message names (`jade config show`). | | `jade401` | invalid playbook | 1 | fix the playbook at the place the message names (`jade playbook check <name>`). | | `jade402` | invalid site spec | 1 | fix the site spec at the place the message names (`jade site check`). | | `jade403` | unknown tool | 1 | the target has no such tool. list them: `jade base tools`. | | `jade404` | ambiguous tool | 1 | more than one target has this tool. name the target. | | `jade405` | not found | 1 | check the name; list what exists with the matching `list` command. | | `jade406` | generated files are stale | 1 | run `python build/build.py` and commit the result. | | `jade500` | doctor failed | 1 | run `jade doctor` and fix what it reports, or pass --force to go on anyway. |
